title: I Was Disabled in Middle Age. It Opened Up the World.
description: Life on the wrong side of the Sharpie line is tough but instructive.
author: Aaron Retica and Joey Solomon

title: U.S. Spy Agencies Suffer Breach of Some Unclassified Information
description: The intrusion affecting the C.I.A. and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence comes amid heightened concerns about cybersecurity.
author: Dustin Volz, Tyler Pager and Julian E. Barnes

title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees, Says He Is in Therapy
description: A day after returning to his company, Mr. Huang acknowledged that he had violated Nvidia’s code of conduct and “made some terrible mistakes.”
author: Tripp Mickle and Kalley Huang

title: Trump Awards Rudy Giuliani Presidential Medal of Freedom
description: The award honored a Trump ally who was once known as “America’s mayor” but whose reputation was tarnished by his efforts to overturn the 2020 election on behalf of the president.
author: Erica L. Green

title: Don’t Let the Lame Duck G.O.P. Ram Through This Bill
description: Congress shouldn’t let Trump use weakened environmental laws to put his favored projects on public lands.
author: Christopher Ketcham and Jimmy Tobias

title: Broderick Wins Tennessee House Race, Giving Democrats Largest Majority in 30 Years
description: Democrats’ midterm rout kept expanding in the House after a tech support worker ousted an eight-term Republican without having aired a single TV ad.
author: John Yoon and Emily Cochrane

title: When You’re a Star They Let You Compromise National Security
description: Huang’s firing damaged something Donald Trump values even more than national security: the stock market.
author: Michelle Goldberg

title: The Navy Waves Goodbye to the Peacoat
description: But don’t worry, fashion will keep it afloat.
author: Vanessa Friedman

title: 100 Notable Books of 2026
description: Here is the standout fiction and nonfiction of the year, chosen by the staff of The New York Times Book Review.

title: Some Haitian Families Fleeing the U.S. for Canada Are Being Separated at the Border
description: Driven to Canada by deportation fears, some members of Haitian families are being denied entry, turned back and detained by U.S. authorities.
author: Miriam Jordan

title: Why the Nvidia Board Folded
description: The whole thing was a pointless and depressing exercise.
author: Natasha Sarin

title: Jane Fonda, De Niro and Other Say Schumer Should Not Be Senate Majority Leader
description: In a letter signed by celebrities and other Democratic donors, the supporters of Senator Chris Van Hollen said a change in leadership from Senator Chuck Schumer was needed after the midterms.
author: Benjamin Oreskes

title: Iranian Singer Receives 74 Lashes for Performing With No Hijab
description: Parastoo Ahmadi sang without wearing the mandatory veil in a virtual concert in 2024 that spread quickly online and drew the ire of the Islamic republic authorities.
author: Ephrat Livni and Leily Nikounazar

title: ‘Melania: The Series’ is a Bloodless, Instantly Dated Travelogue of Power
description: Amazon’s brief follow-up to the documentary film about Melania Trump is a portrait of a figure who resists being understood.
author: James Poniewozik

title: Medicare Hospice Caps Leave Patients Without Care
description: Critics say the payment limits to companies penalize patients who are not dying on the government’s timetable.
author: Christopher Rowland

title: The Army Rejected a Cleaner Option to Destroy Lead-Laced Explosives in Iowa
description: The Army had hired a firm to turn the explosives into harmless waste, but then dropped it in favor of a controlled blast that could launch lead dust across Iowa.
author: Hiroko Tabuchi and John Ismay

title: Over 700,000 Russian Soldiers Have Died in Ukraine, Analysis Indicates
description: Hacked government data underscores the immense human cost of President Vladimir V. Putin’s war of attrition.
author: Paul Sonne

title: Translating the Language of Trees
description: A book puts words to the sights and sounds that emanate from the giants in your backyard.
author: Margaret Roach

title: Fact-Checking Stephen Miller, the New White House Chief of Staff
description: Mr. Miller has promoted some of the second Trump administration’s most egregious falsehoods about immigration policy, the economy and political opposition.
author: Linda Qiu

title: Some of Russia’s A.I. Drones Are Powered by Nvidia Microcomputers, Ukrainian Officials Say
description: The tech giant says it does not sell the devices in Russia, but they are widely available on resale markets. When purchased that way, they are virtually impossible to track.
author: Andrew E. Kramer
